en: A lever does not reduce the total work needed; it reduces the effort force by requiring you to push over a longer distance.
Friction between your rubber shoes and the ground pushes you forward when you walk, so friction does not always slow objects down.
Without air resistance, a heavy bowling ball and a light feather dropped from the same height hit the ground at exactly the same time.
A magnet cannot pick up a gold ring or an aluminum can because only iron, nickel, and cobalt are strongly attracted to magnets.
A light switch does not create or supply electricity; it only opens or closes the path for current to flow through a circuit.
Light from the Sun reaches Earth through the vacuum of space, proving light does not need air or any material to travel.
Sound cannot travel through outer space because it requires a material medium like air, water, or a solid to carry its vibrations.
A metal spoon in hot soup does not produce heat; it conducts thermal energy from the hot soup to your hand.
A ball sitting still at the top of a hill has gravitational potential energy because of its height, even though it is not moving.
If you break a bar magnet in half, each piece becomes a new magnet with its own north pole and south pole.
A battery stores chemical energy, not electric current; the chemical energy converts into electrical energy only when connected in a complete circuit.
A single fixed pulley attached to a ceiling does not reduce the lifting force needed; it only changes the direction you pull.
